description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'FeatureDefinitionNotAccessibleException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It indicates that a feature definition on a thing does not exist or access was insufficient. The class includes methods to create instances from messages or JSON, and contains a nested builder class for constructing exception objects.

classes.name: FeatureDefinitionNotAccessibleException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception when a feature definition is inaccessible, such as not existing or insufficient permissions. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ThingException, providing static methods for creation and a nested builder class.

classes.name: FeatureDefinitionNotAccessibleException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing instances of FeatureDefinitionNotAccessibleException with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance initialized with provided ThingId and featureId.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a FeatureDefinitionNotAccessibleException from a given message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a FeatureDefinitionNotAccessibleException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the specified DittoHeaders.
